rationale: Bind.unpack requires a class declaration, exact stored field order, distinct pattern fields/destinations, destination freshness, and Transfer of all fields. Transfer's nil requires no remaining fields and its cons selects a named slot, so permutation is allowed without loss or duplication. The resulting state removes only the enclosing object entry and prepends all transferred slots, including none, leaving the counter unchanged. Step first Eval then Bind matches the displayed combined rule and variable-binding alternative. given.patterns/state/evaluation introduce its syntax and judgments.
